sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners; the learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners that the present matter relates to matrimonial dispute, which may be amicably settled by way of mediation and conciliation, therefore, the matter may be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court.
Issue notice to the respondent No. 4, returnable at an early date.
Steps be taken within a week by ordinary process as well as by registered post.

In view of the above, it is directed that petitioners shall deposit a sum of Rs. 35,000/-
within three weeks from today with the Mediation Centre of this Court, out of which Rs.30,000/- shall be paid to the opposite party no. 4 by way of demand draft made in her favour on the date fixed for her appearance before the Mediation Centre and

further the demand draft of Rs.5000/- made in the name of 'Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre' shall be deposited with the Mediation Centre and the same may be retained by the Mediation Centre as mediation fee.

entities.text: Allahabad High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The matter is remitted to the Mediation Centre with the direction that after deposit of such amount by the petitioners, it shall issue notice to the parties fixing some date for mediation and shall make all possible efforts to conclude the mediation and conciliation proceedings expeditiously, preferably within a period of four months.
List after expiry of aforesaid period before the appropriate Bench along with the report of Mediation Centre.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners in the above mentioned case.

It is made clear that in case there occurs default by the petitioners either in depositing the amount or in appearing before the Mediation Centre on the date fixed,
